topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the pages, hidden between the old comics and the dusty, forgotten trinkets in the attic. Each word, a familiar dance, a waltz through our days and nights, penned in the quiet moments I never knew were captured. It's a novel, every chapter a shadow of us walking the city streets, our whispered conversations under the stars. I wonder how much of me is real in these lines, how deeply I've been woven into the fabric of the story. The room feels smaller, the air a bit thicker, as I turn the pages, each one a new breath, a new secret. I don't know what to say, or if I should say anything at all.
